column1: # Arabic formulae used inside Persian. The detector drops a scored span that is
# exactly one, the Quran index a match wholly inside one; a longer Arabic clause
# The first 26 were listed by hand. The last seven were added once their uses in
# a development partition were read and some were found inside Persian (from 1 of
# 10 for لا اله الا الله to 10 of 10 for حور عین). ما شاء الله was read and left
# out: all ten uses audited were inside Arabic.
صلی الله علیه و آله و سلم
انا لله و انا الیه راجعون
